task.name: replace a bicycle tire inner tube
task.outcome_evidence: The person successfully inserts the inner tube into the bicycle tire and mounts it onto the rim.

narration.text: So if you do have a flat and you pump up your tube
you can see exactly where the hole would be.
And it makes it a lot easier for uh for fixing flats.
So you just put the one side on and then you're going to get your tube
Make sure that you pump up the tube slightly so it becomes round
so it's easier to put inside the tire and also so you don't pinch it
um when you're putting on the other side.

actions.observed_action: The person holds up a bicycle wheel and points to a tire and tube.
actions.instruction: Hold up the bicycle wheel with the tire and tube.
actions.visual_evidence: The person is holding a wheel with one side of the tire off the rim and a tube visible.
actions.inferred_reason: To demonstrate the setup for fixing a flat tire.

actions.observed_action: The person places the wheel down on the workbench and sets one side of the tire onto the rim.
actions.instruction: Mount one side of the tire onto the wheel rim.
actions.visual_evidence: The person places the wheel on the table and works the tire bead into the rim channel.

stated_reason.text: So you just put the one side on

actions.observed_action: The person grabs an inner tube and connects it to a pump nozzle to inflate it slightly.
actions.instruction: Inflate the inner tube slightly so it holds its shape.
actions.visual_evidence: The person picks up the tube and connects the valve to the pump hose on the right.

stated_reason.text: Make sure that you pump up the tube slightly so it becomes round

actions.observed_action: The person picks up the inflated inner tube and begins tucking it inside the bicycle tire.
actions.instruction: Place the slightly inflated inner tube inside the tire channel.
actions.visual_evidence: The person holds the tube and works it into the cavity between the tire and the rim.

stated_reason.text: so it's easier to put inside the tire and also so you don't pinch it um when you're putting on the other side.
